description: box-sizing: border-box counts padding and border inside a declared width and height and cannot shrink the box below them; the default content-box still adds them.

florui.css: .a { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100px; height: 60px; padding: 20px; border: 4px solid #1e3a8a; background-color: #4c8bf5; margin-bottom: 8px; } .b { width: 60px; height: 30px; padding: 10px; border: 4px solid #1e3a8a; background-color: #2f7d6c; margin-bottom: 8px; } .c { box-sizing: border-box; width: 10px; height: 10px; padding: 12px; background-color: #c0392b; }
